header.notes: Medicaid expansion: 41 jurisdictions as of November 2026 (not expanded: AL, FL, GA, KS, MS, SC, TN, TX, WI, WY; Wisconsin covers adults to 100% FPL without expansion, so it has no coverage gap). State names from the Medicaid.gov eligibility table, count confirmed by KFF 2026-11-06. `stateBasedExchanges` is the PLAN YEAR 2027 list (22): Oregon leaves HealthCare.gov for its own platform in 2027. State-based exchanges that use the federal platform (Arkansas; Oklahoma from 2027) enroll through HealthCare.gov and are therefore NOT listed. DC (to about 215% FPL) and the Basic Health Programs of MN and NY (to 200%) cover adults above 138%; not modelled by the single threshold. sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (this file without `header`, JSON.stringify with no whitespace).
